test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She was so busy ______writing that when the maid came ______she didn’t hear her.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**busy in**" is commonly used to indicate involvement in an activity, while "**came in"** indicates entry.
 
• Other options do not fit the context effectively.

Hence, the correct statement is **'*She was so busy in__ writing that when the maid came in she didn’t hear her*.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The preposition **"in**" is often used with activities, such as "**busy in writing**," "**engaged in cooking**," etc.
 
• Prepositions should be chosen carefully to match the context of the sentence.
